label: Bible Study
prompt: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, _____ not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verse: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
note: Three verses before the eagles' wings — the God who never gets tired gives strength to those who do.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and _____, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verse: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
note: After the flood, God's standing promise: seedtime and harvest, summer and winter — the seasons will keep showing up.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Also he sent forth a _____ from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verse: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
note: Noah's first scout was a raven that never reported back; the dove was the second try, and the one we remember.

label: Deep Water
prompt: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the _____ of the Lord Jesus.
verse: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
note: Paul signs off Galatians pointing to his scars — the only marks in the flesh he cares to boast about.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be _____.
verse: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
note: Paul's one-line parenting rule: don't provoke your children, 'lest they be discouraged.'
